Start the ssoosshd server.

Available modes:
  full - webserver, listener, and in-process signer (default for bare 'serve')
  api  - webserver and listener only; requires separate signer process

## Synopsis

```
ssoosshd serve [command] [flags]
```

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoosshd`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoosshd/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to the ssoosshd config file |

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ssoosshd serve api`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoosshd/serve-api/) | Run the server without the signer (API mode). |
| [`ssoosshd serve full`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoosshd/serve-full/) | Run the server with webserver, listener, and in-process signer. |
